# M78 technical plan: current Scope 1 candidate inventory

Date: 2026-09-17. Task: M78-CTO-01. Owner: CTO fallback `/root/m77_backend`. Status: design only; product, accounting-policy and independent technical acceptance pending. No implementation or hosted authorization is conveyed by this document.

## Decision and sequence

Implement the [M78 product brief](m78-product-brief.md) as one milestone with two new immutable families: `process_screen` and `inventory`. Reuse the existing corporate/source/discovery writers, deterministic calculation authorities, evidence statements and review rules. Add one migration, `0021_scope1_inventory.sql`, with a separately reviewed security section. Preserve every byte of migrations 0001–0020 and every historical application record.

**Choose a factual corporate successor before family rebinding.** Root identified a current subsidiary boundary decision with missing Scope 1 inclusion/control support and an empty rationale. A process non-applicability screen cannot repair this boundary. An M78 scoped finding-resolution table cannot override an unresolved entity boundary, unsupported consolidation, missing control evidence, geography or temporal allocation.

1. Capture the complete fresh accepted schema-20 graph and family histories. Compare all retained IDs, relationships and source/physical bindings; preserve all corporate v8 objects, including all three facilities and the two same-named distribution sites.
2. Through the existing M71 save/review path, append a supported successor (expected v9 only if no intervening writer). Retain all identities and existing source/facility/entity objects. Change only supported factual boundary/control/coverage fields, with retained fictional control evidence, full-year intervals, an explicit inclusion rationale and a correction reason. Explain each changed field. No unknown control fact is asserted true merely to obtain acceptance.
3. Obtain distinct eligible acceptance of this exact corporate successor. If supplied evidence cannot support inclusion, keep the inventory blocked. Select this exact accepted corporate version as the final coverage authority for the demonstration.
4. Bind the detailed process screen to that final corporate version. Append and separately review all stale source heads: two gas, one stationary diesel, two mobile and five fugitive expected at baseline. Append/review the fleet, stationary equipment and fugitive population successors after source dependencies are final. Existing physical facts and activity remain unchanged unless a supported correction is explicitly made. New coverage bindings and recreated evidence hashes can change calculation/result hashes while emitted quantities remain identical.
5. Build, review and report the exact candidate inventory. Correct one source, demonstrate stale inventory, then append/review the new dependency closure and preserve every old report. Revisit after restart and restore.

The supplementary process screen resolves only explicit process coverage assertions in the M78 inventory. Original M71 findings remain retained; M71 completeness remains `incomplete`. Scope 2/3 and legal gaps remain visible. Any subsequent corporate correction makes every family bound to the prior coverage version stale again.

### Exact baseline evidence check

Read-only inspection of the frozen original M77 journal, full-file SHA `84107d09d979d0a5086a575642ddd1f3d596f75213886588f909b047933860ba`, recovered corporate v8 `8344d598-afda-458b-8376-39487cc7416c`, version hash `b8b68644f1a053d789ad7a296da25735bd7f4fae3659ddd13f3a3bbd500f2004` and all 106 findings. This is retained historical authority, not a fresh hosted read.

The exact M71 artifact900 says: “Entities: California parent and California distribution subsidiary. Wholly owned; operational control.” Its retained profile period is 2025-01-01/end-exclusive2026-01-01; it expressly contains no activity measurements or legal conclusions. This supports the **bounded fictional declared ownership/control** correction below, subject to accounting approval; no evidence-admission extension is required for those exact facts. It does not support real-company control, a negative process inspection, service records or activity measurements. Do not repurpose its locator to claim any of those.

- Relationship `71000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010`: ownershipPercent already `100`; controlFacts null and evidenceRefs empty. Add a precise declared ownership/operational-control explanation and reference artifact900, SHA `4fe7dc12d8f253f8d3cb1fd7fba2eade05f3d605ad7cb95376cca9d957afe5c7`, locator `synthetic-register:entities-and-screening`.
- Subsidiary boundary `71000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000041`, entity `.002`: disposition `missing`, reason null, references empty. Correct to supported bounded inclusion with the same annual-register reference and an explicit entity/control rationale; retain its existing ID and full-year interval.
- Parent boundary `71000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000040`, entity `.001`: existing rationale mentions only the owned diesel vehicle. Explain group/entity inclusion for the full declared annual inventory against the same limited register rather than implying a vehicle statement proves every activity.

New detailed process-location/negative-screen evidence belongs in retained M78 statements. If later proposed boundary facts exceed what artifact900 declares, require a separately reviewed additive evidence-admission design; do not relabel the existing artifact or silently bypass M71's source whitelist.

## Observed reuse constraints

These limits come from the current contracts and are admission limits, not targets or permission to truncate. Recheck counts and byte budgets against the fresh baseline before writing a recipe.

| Current family | Observed limit / authority | M78 action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| M71 corporate | 40 versions; 50,000-byte snapshot; 4 MB response; each collection ≤150; evidence references resolve only to the pinned M71 synthetic artifact/locator | Existing successor preserves all prior collection IDs and immutable relationship/source bindings. If current pinned fictional evidence does not support the corrected control facts, stop and propose an explicitly reviewed additive evidence mechanism; no invented reference or silent validator bypass. |
| M73 natural gas | 3 streams; 40 versions; 3.8 MB history / 4 MB response | Existing dedicated consumed-fuel authority; exact CO2/CH4/N2O results; append binding successors |
| M74 mobile diesel | 3 streams; 40 versions; 3.8 MB history / 4 MB response | Existing separate gallons/mileage authority and stable vehicle identity; no mileage substitution |
| M76 stationary diesel | 1 stream; 40 versions; 40 reports; 3.8 MB history / 4 MB response | Existing consumed-gallons/default-HHV authority; preserve estimate basis |
| M75 fleet / M76 stationary discovery | Each 25 assets, 40 versions/reports, 100,000-byte version, 131,072-byte report, 3.8 MB history / 4 MB response | Preserve discovery universe, links and separate dependency reviews; do not widen silently |
| M77 fugitive | 8 source streams, 25 assets, 40 total new-family versions, 80 reports; 8 MB history / 10 MB response | Existing Python/SQL/browser algebra and permanent event reservations; append all necessary source/population bindings within remaining budget |

Current data functions in `workspace.ts` already expose `findCorporateInventory`, `findStationaryGas`, `findMobileDiesel`, `findStationaryDiesel`, `findControlledFleet`, `findStationaryEquipment` and `findFugitive`. Existing family reads validate retained lineage and replay authority results; M78 must consume their verified outputs, not raw claimed hashes. Read the four calculation families with injected existing authorities in one company-scoped transaction; no global transport override.

## Public shared types and pure functions

New paths: `packages/neuvetra-database/src/m78-contract.ts`, `m78-validation.ts`, `m78-reconciliation.ts`, `m78-report.ts`, `m78.ts`. Export them through `index.ts`; only browser-safe files may be imported by the web decoder. UUIDs and SHA-256 values use the existing lowercase validators; text is canonical NFC with exact-field validation. Timestamps are UTC millisecond ISO strings. All arithmetic values are nonnegative canonical decimal strings; JSON numbers are forbidden for activity, gas mass and CO2e.

| Export | Exact semantic shape |
| --- | --- |
| `M78Pin` | `{id,sha256}`; exact retained record, never an arbitrary hash claim |
| `M78Family` | `process_screen` or `inventory` |
| `M78CoverageBinding` | `{coverageVersionId,coverageVersionSha256,processCoverageItemId,period:{start,endExclusive}}`; period exactly 2025-01-01 through end-exclusive 2026-01-01 |
| `M78EvidenceInput` | `{reference,issuer,description,issuedOn,purpose,entityId,facilityId}`; purpose one of `business_activity`, `process_inspection`, `offsite_discovery`; nullable location only for an explicitly described non-facility operation |
| `M78ProcessLocation` | `{rowId,entityId,facilityId,operationId,businessActivities,equipmentAndMaterials,controlExplanation,evidenceReferences}`; stable `operationId` for non-facility operations; no missing-location default |
| `M78ProcessAssessment` | `{rowId,category,discoveredSourceId,locationRowIds,disposition,reason,evidenceReferences}`; categories are fixed supported screening keys, plus `other_direct_process`; disposition `unknown`, `indicated`, `not_applicable_proposed` |
| `M78ProcessActivity` | `{profile:'synthetic-process-screen-v1',binding,declaration:{completeness,coveredEntityIds,coveredFacilityIds,allControlledOperationsIncluded,discoveryBasis}|null,locations,assessments,evidenceStatements,manualConfirmation}`; completeness `unknown`, `partial`, `declared_complete` |
| `M78SourcePin` | `{family,worksheetId,sourceId,physicalId,version:M78Pin,decision:M78Pin|null}`; family `natural_gas`, `stationary_diesel`, `mobile_diesel`, `fugitive`; physicalId derived through authoritative discovery; null is a blocker, not omitted |
| `M78Dependencies` | `{coveragePin,coverageReviewPin,processVersionPin,processReviewPin,sourcePins,discoveryPins,policySha256,rulesVersion,dependencySha256}`; discoveryPins contain family, version, exact decision or null, dependency hash and reconciliation hash; all arrays sorted by stable IDs |
| `M78InventoryActivity` | `{profile:'synthetic-scope1-inventory-v1',binding,note}`; callers cannot select convenient older source heads or submit totals/resolutions/contributors |
| `M78Finding` | `{code,origin:{family,recordId,originalCode},classification,message,resolution}`; classification `functional_blocker`, `release_blocker`, `corporate_gap`, `resolved_bounded`; resolution null or exact typed dependency/evidence pins plus rule ID |
| `M78GasContribution` | `{sourceId,family,physicalId,entityId,facilityId,gas,gasKind,massKgExact,co2eKgExact,originalMass,originalMassUnit,methodPin,gwpPolicyPin,estimateBasis}`; gasKind `single_gas` or `blend`; no inferred constituents |
| `M78Totals` | `{gasLines,sourceRows,facilityRows,entityRows,company:{kgCo2eExact,kgCo2eDisplay,rounding:'half_even_4dp'},displayRoundingDelta}`; complete union identities included; null/partial totals explicitly labeled |
| `M78Reconciliation` | `{dependencies,sourceUnion,findings,knownSourceSubtotal,totals,status,contentSha256}`; status `blocked` or `reconciled_bounded_synthetic`; full totals null when functional blockers or incompatible numerical policy exist |

`M78Version` has `{id,companyId,streamId,family,version,previousVersionId,previousVersionSha256,createdBy,createdAt,contributorIds,correctionReason,activity,dependencies,statements,findings,reconciliation,inputSha256,contentSha256,versionSha256,synthetic:true,scope1Completeness:'incomplete',corporateCompleteness:'incomplete',releaseEligible:false,assurance:'none',review}`. Process reconciliation is null; inventory reconciliation is the captured deterministic result. Stored version.review is null; authenticated reads attach its exact retained review separately.

Required functions: `parseM78Json`, `validateM78ProcessSave`, `validateM78InventorySave`, `validateM78Review`, `validateM78Report`, `m78CanonicalJson`, `m78ValidateProcessCorrection`, `buildM78Dependencies`, `deriveM78ProcessFindings`, `mapM78CorporateFindings`, `deriveM78Reconciliation`, `m78InputHashPayload`, `m78ContentHashPayload`, `m78VersionHashPayload`, `m78ReviewHashPayload`, `m78ReportHashPayload`, `m78EvidenceText`, `m78RenderReport`. Derivation accepts a hash callback for browser-safe asynchronous hash memoization; it never accepts caller-supplied authoritative findings.

Initial process category keys: `mineral_products`, `chemical_production`, `metal_production`, `oil_and_gas`, `waste_treatment`, `agricultural_biological`, `other_direct_process`. Require one full-discovery applicability assessment per category, plus individually identified indicated sources. Every retained entity/location and declared non-facility operation must be covered by each assessment's scope/evidence or an explicit supported category-specific rationale. Category labels are screening questions, not released process methods. Unsupported direct gas usage stays indicated; it cannot bypass the physical fugitive union as a category rename.

## Hash, proof and cumulative contributor contract

Use the existing canonical key-sorted JSON algorithm and UTF-8 byte hashing; array order is canonicalized only where specified and cloned before normalization. Reject duplicate JSON keys, extra keys, prototype-key gas lookup attacks, invalid dates and unknown enumerations. No float, implicit date or default-zero interpretation.

- `inputSha256 = H(activity)`.
- `dependencySha256 = H(dependencies without dependencySha256)`.
- `contentSha256 = H({activity,dependencies,statements,findings,reconciliation})`.
- `versionSha256 = H(version without versionSha256 and review)`; contributors and predecessor hashes are included.
- `decisionSha256 = H({companyId,...review without decisionSha256})`; review contains version ID/hash, exact dependencies, decision, note, acknowledged limitations, reviewer ID/time.
- Retained statement text is `SYNTHETIC — NOT ORIGINAL CUSTOMER EVIDENCE\n` plus canonical `{companyId,year:2025,...evidenceInput}` plus newline; locator `m78-evidence:<statementUUID>:<reference>`; hash/byteLength are over that exact text. References must resolve within the captured version and agree with location, purpose and issuer.
- Report snapshot exact keys: `{profile:'m78-report-snapshot-v1',family,version,review,proof,reconciliation,limitations}`. Proof includes only required captured corporate/source/discovery/process versions, exact decisions or null, evidence and policy artifact. Every historical pin resolves against retained records; a later review cannot replace captured null. Historical source versions are permitted only inside historical proof, never effective current selection.
- `snapshotJson` is canonical snapshot text; `snapshotSha256` hashes its bytes; `html` equals the deterministic renderer over the snapshot; `htmlSha256` and `htmlByteLength` describe exact UTF-8 bytes. `reportSha256 = H(report without html,snapshotJson,reportSha256)`; pinned byte hashes remain included.

Contributors are the sorted union of the actor, all predecessor contributor sets, corporate version contributors, selected source-version contributors, discovery-version contributors and process-screen contributors. Include every authoring actor from those lineages; never reset on rebinding, role changes or label-only corrections. Dependency review actors are retained as decision provenance; performing a review alone does not turn an actor into a preparer. Any reviewer who authored a selected or historical contributing version remains ineligible. Exact eligible role, tenant membership and staging access are checked at save/review time. If no distinct eligible reviewer exists, stop and show the dependency; never grant access in a recipe.

## Finding mapping: no blanket filter

Map every M71 finding by its record's domain, not only its code. Preserve original code/record/message and deterministic resolution evidence. Unknown new codes default to functional blocker for Scope 1/global boundary records; unrelated domains remain corporate gaps. No deletion of the 106 baseline findings.

| M71 finding | M78 disposition / required authority |
| --- | --- |
| `unsupported_consolidation`, `unsupported_geography`, `unsupported_temporal_allocation`, `unsupported_boundary_relationship`, `control_evidence_missing`, `boundary_unreconciled`, `boundary_basis_missing`, `boundary_assertion_unverified` | Functional blocker. Only a supported current corporate correction and exact eligible review can resolve an admitted full-year operational-control fact. Process screen never overrides these. Unsupported geography/control/period stays registered and blocked. |
| `activity_unknown` on included Scope 1 source screening | Resolve bounded only through matching current reviewed source calculation/evidence; null corporate screening quantity is not fabricated into a quantity or zero. Missing workpaper stays blocked. |
| `activity_unknown` on process group | Resolve as coverage non-applicability only through complete accepted process screen bound to the exact group row/current coverage. It produces no emissions quantity. Indicated/unknown process remains blocked. |
| `activity_unknown` on stationary/mobile/fugitive group | Resolve through the full eligible corporate/physical/workpaper union and exact accepted discovery dependencies. A source subtotal alone is insufficient. |
| `evidence_incomplete`, `evidence_conflicting`, `screening_basis_missing`, `screening_assertion_unverified`, `estimate_unverified` in Scope 1 | Functional blocker unless an explicit rule reconstructs supported current evidence/disposition/estimate from the authoritative family. Conflict never cleared by hashing. No general excluded-source override in the first profile. |
| `method_unsupported` on included Scope 1 activity | Current supported candidate family may resolve functional method admission; retain a separate method-release blocker. Unsupported process/fuel/equipment remains functional blocker. On non-applicable process coverage, retain screened applicability and no method/zero fabrication. |
| `synthetic_evidence_not_sufficient`, `methods_not_released` | Release blockers always retained. Fictional evidence can support only bounded synthetic demonstration; no production completeness. |
| `requirements_not_determined`, `requirement_unknown`, `requirement_conflicting` | Corporate/legal gaps and reporting-release blockers; never converted into an applicability determination by M78 |
| Findings on electricity/other Scope 2/Scope 3 rows | Corporate gaps; remain visible and prevent whole-corporate completion, without being mistaken for a missing Scope 1 numerical source |

Family findings receive the same typed mapping. Generic `scope1_incomplete` becomes a retained family-subtotal limitation resolved only for the M78 functional union, while M78 Scope1 completeness still remains incomplete for release. `method_not_released` remains a release blocker. Every actual stale/incomplete/duplicate/unsupported/review-required family finding remains functional blocker. Exact derivation, not a hand-maintained allowlist of convenient messages, establishes any bounded resolution.

## Decimal authority and candidate accounting policy

New `m78-reconciliation.ts` uses exact base-10 integer coefficients/scales, canonical decimal strings and explicit kg/g conversion. SQL uses exact `numeric` and explicit half-even helper parity. Verify CO2e against each family's retained result and pinned method; rollups sum unrounded contributions once, never displayed subtotals. R-410A emitted mass is one blend line; linked prior release is already included in the 2 kg refill estimate, yielding 3848.0000 kg CO2e once. Preserve tiny HFC-227ea and rollup tie cases. Reject negative input, netting fields and offsets; no synthetic rounding adjustment emissions.

Natural-gas physical identity comes from its exact M76 equipment/source link, not a guessed meter display name. Diesel/mobile/fugitive identities must likewise agree with the authoritative discovery tuple. A shared annual activity/evidence reference across effective sources is unresolved unless a supported nonoverlapping allocation rule exists; rebinding reuse within one source lineage is legitimate. An incompatible/unreviewed GWP policy permits separate gas masses and separately labeled family CO2e values, but no combined company CO2e or combined CO2e subtotal.

Add `docs/research/m78-accounting-contract.md` and a fixed `M78_CANDIDATE_POLICY` artifact only after **independent accounting review**. It must enumerate exact M73/M74/M76-diesel method/factor/GWP pins and M77 guidance/factor pins, accepted gas mappings, gas units, GWP basis, blend-disclosure limits, estimate status and supported profiles. Its review is a release dependency, not a caller-provided boolean. Pending/incompatible policy blocks company CO2e coherence. Review cannot promote development candidates to released production factors or resolve rights. Do not silently reweight historical results.

## Proposed schema 21

One database author owns `0021_scope1_inventory.sql`. No earlier SQL edits. Add eight tables with the same tenant-composite FK and immutable-history pattern as schema20:

| Table | Keys and purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `scope1_heads` | UUID id, company_id FK, family enum, year=2025, version_id, revision; unique(company_id,year,family), unique(id,company_id); only mutable head pointer |
| `scope1_statements` | id/company, payload, statement_text, statement_sha256; unique(id,company_id) |
| `scope1_versions` | id/company/stream, revision, predecessor, coverage_version_id, family, payload, input/content/version hashes, created_by/time, export_text; unique(company,stream,revision), tenant FKs to head/predecessor/corporate |
| `scope1_reviews` | id/company/version, payload, decision hash, reviewer/time; unique(company,version,dependency hash); tenant version FK |
| `scope1_reports` | id/company/stream/version, payload, report hash, creator/time; tenant stream/version FKs |
| `scope1_requests` | primary key(company,idempotency_key), actor, operation, family, stream, fingerprint, record_id; exact actor/request replay only |
| `scope1_audit` | ordered sequence, unique id, company, record_id, operation, record hash, actor/time; one exact audit per retained save/review/report |
| `scope1_process_discoveries` | company/year/discovery_key primary key; stream_id, first_version_id, location identity; permanently reserves every indicated stable process identity across successors |

Enable and force RLS. Runtime reads require staging access plus company membership; runtime has SELECT only, no direct DML. Revoke PUBLIC/authenticated/runtime helper execution and sequences; grant only narrowly named authorized writer/lock functions to runtime. History statements/versions/reviews/reports/requests/audit/discoveries reject UPDATE/DELETE. Bind head targets and all references through `(id,company_id)` FKs.

Functions: `m78_lock(uuid,boolean)`, `m78_validate_activity(text,jsonb,jsonb)`, `m78_dependencies(...)`, `m78_process_findings(...)`, `m78_reconciliation(...)`, `m78_validate_process_correction(jsonb,jsonb)`, `m78_render_report(jsonb)`, `save_scope1_version(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb)`, `review_scope1_version(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb)`, `create_scope1_report(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb)`. Specify final typed helper signatures when authoring; exposed writer signatures above are fixed. SQL independently reconstructs authority from retained current rows; caller payload/hashes cannot supply source selection, resolutions, contributor sets, total authority or report semantics.

All writers use existing `m71_lock` authorization, then company row FOR UPDATE and deterministic head lock ordering. This company lock serializes corporate and family changes before pin checks. Reading takes the company share lock and a consistent transaction snapshot. Reject stale expected head/dependency/reconciliation pins with `23505`/HTTP409, invalid facts/semantic payload with `22023`/422, forbidden with `42501`/403. Integrity failure during retained read returns generic503 and no partial protected report. Idempotency scope includes actor/company/family/stream/operation/request, excluding only key; no retry after uncertain hosted outcome.

Security author supplied these six source signatures and the proposed fixed path. All are no-argument invoker functions; actual catalog metadata remains the authority for overloads, ownership and current configuration. Integrate this exact reviewed section through the sole database writer:

```sql
ALTER FUNCTION neuvetra.electricity_source_fixtures() SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp;
ALTER FUNCTION neuvetra.reject_inventory_history_mutation() SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp;
ALTER FUNCTION neuvetra.m67_method() SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp;
ALTER FUNCTION neuvetra.m67_limitations() SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp;
ALTER FUNCTION neuvetra.m68_limitations() SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp;
ALTER FUNCTION neuvetra.annual_evidence_report_template() SET search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp;
```

Preflight captures exact definitions, language, owner, invoker/definer mode, volatility, ACL/effective runtime privileges and proconfig from root's metadata-only query `m78-neuvetra-function-metadata.sql`. Postflight proves only those six existing proconfig values changed plus admitted new objects; literal outputs/report history remain byte exact and the trigger still refuses UPDATE/DELETE with42501. Do not modify `public.set_updated_at`, whose definition is a separate unresolved security boundary. Keep owners, definitions, flags, ACLs and grants unchanged; no ad hoc schema20 edits or elevated runtime privileges. If root must deliver security earlier, reserve a reviewed security-only migration21 and place M78 in22 instead; never create two divergent migration21 receipts. Root selects one sequencing path before implementation.

## API, database and frontend contracts

New API `apps/site-api/src/workspace/m78-routes.ts`, factory `createM78Routes({database,validateUser,origin,authorities,policy})`. Mount through `apps/site-api/src/workspace/server.ts`. Database integration adds `findScope1`, `findScope1Version`, `findScope1Report`, `findScope1Proof`, `saveProcessScreen`, `saveScope1Inventory`, `reviewScope1Version`, `createScope1Report` in `workspace.ts`/`hosted.ts`. Existing actor transaction setup is retained; every route enforces bearer authentication, origin restrictions, company access, no-store and narrow content/security headers.

Routes use `/workspace/:company/(process-screen|scope1-inventory)`:

- GET base: current dependencies/reconciliation, head pins, version/review/report metadata; no multiplied complete report histories.
- POST base or `/:stream/versions`: exact activity plus `{expectedVersionId,expectedVersionSha256,expectedDependencySha256,correctionReason,idempotencyKey}`; first save uses null predecessor/reason. Input never contains calculated fields or selected source pins. Inventory saves capture server-current dependencies even when blocked.
- GET `/:stream/versions/:version`: exact retained version, review and dependency proof; GET `.../inventory-export` gives exact export bytes.
- POST `/:stream/reviews`: `{versionId,expectedVersionSha256,expectedDependencySha256,decision,note,acknowledgedLimitations,idempotencyKey}`; decisions process `accepted_bounded_process_screen`, inventory `accepted_bounded_inventory`, either `changes_requested`. Acceptance requires current exact closure and no functional blockers. Release blockers remain acknowledged; pending reports are allowed.
- POST `/:stream/reports`: `{versionId,expectedVersionSha256,expectedDecisionId,expectedDecisionSha256,expectedReconciliationSha256,idempotencyKey}`; explicit null review pins permitted for retained blocked/pending history. Process reconciliation pin is null.
- GET `/:stream/reports/:report`: exact report object; `/download`, `/snapshot`, `/proof` give HTML, canonical JSON and exact dependency closure respectively. GET `/:stream/statements/:statement/download` returns retained text only after company/reference authorization.

## Capacity and read-cost contract

Proposed new-family caps: one screen and one inventory head/company/year; 25 process location/operation rows; 100 assessment rows; 100 evidence statements/version; 40 versions across both new families; 80 reports/company; 200,000-byte activity; 4 MB exact proof/report snapshot; 20 MB retained new-family history; 6 MB individual response. Reject before commit when a cap would be exceeded; no slicing, silent pagination loss or dropped unsupported rows. If actual baseline proof exceeds a proposed cap, pause for reviewed capacity adjustment instead of reducing proof scope.

Keep GET register metadata compact and serve exact dependency closure on version/report routes. Do not inline every report or every historical family in every new response. Existing family readers currently replay retained history; reuse them once per transaction/read phase and memoize only verified immutable IDs within that phase. At most two concurrent independent authenticated GETs in hosted test orchestration; serial POSTs, no global fetch override and no cache across baseline/exercise/final/revisit. Fresh head/review checks are never replaced by cache.

Before release, measure request count, bytes and elapsed read/export/revisit cost on the exact fresh actual-derived graph with all history. The previous >10-minute export sweeps are a known tool-cost constraint, not evidence of a cause of M77's interrupted read. Log safe stage/status/request-count/error-category diagnostics; no credentials or bodies. Do not redesign old calculators or relax validation to meet a time target.
